s1.desc: a living room with a cream sofa drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: wide: Pax on the cream sofa plays on the iFin, which carries a small pink Polly figurine charm (pink penguin with orange feet and a head tuft, full-res crop f10), then lays it on the sofa f30-36; Polly stands in front. Charm visible throughout (same Polly charm other curators drop as lead_copy in PlushHug, Finally, Arm)
medium of Pax on the sofa with the phone and its Polly figurine charm lying beside him (full-res crop f60, visible f45-97)

spans.view: with the end of the sofa and its yellow scallop-shell armrest beside her and the rim of a glass coffee table in front

beats.text: Polly stands with her flippers clasped under her beak, gazing up wide-eyed and moving her beak as she talks
Polly squeezes her eyes tightly shut, her flippers still clasped under her beak
Polly opens her eyes, now brimming with tears, and looks up pleadingly with her beak open

spans.view: with the cream sofa behind them and a glass coffee table in the foreground

beats.text: Pax lands from a hop in front of the sofa and crouches with his eyes squeezed shut
